title: Fuel-bounded exclusive-OR construction
statement: For a natural-number fuel and a finite list of pairs of Boolean circuit trees, define a pair recursively as follows. With zero fuel, or with an empty list, return the pair consisting of the empty disjunction circuit and the empty conjunction circuit; with positive fuel and a singleton list, return its sole pair; with positive fuel and at least two pairs, combine the first two by the pairwise construction and recurse on the resulting list with one less fuel.
